scope: Standalone MC_INPUT_ACTION typed result-cache design and ABI validation; no live controller pass claimed

boolean.signature: bool __stdcall(Entity*, int hook, int action, bool* output)

numeric.signature: bool __stdcall(Entity*, uintptr_t unused, int action, float* output)
numeric.return: AL is handled; hook is always 2; RET16

native_abi.unhandled: Output remains untouched; original caller executes its own raw input branch.
native_abi.guard_patterns: Both prologues, both RET16 epilogues, both dispatcher calls and native Entity Index getter were checked against J374 instructions.

policy.authoritative: Every Update/canonical query executes natively, including repeated, recursive and nested mod-driven Game:Update calls. Query count is not fixed at 60 per second.
policy.pure: Reuse latest completed sample for the same key in the current fixed tick; never execute Lua to fill a miss.
policy.missing_or_nil: Return handled=false without writing output; preserve original caller controller index, online aggregation, flags and raw-query behavior.
policy.null_entity: valid key; callback arguments do not contain controller index
policy.record_order: Store after original returns; latest completed outer result wins over a reentrant inner sample; no ordinal matching.
policy.lifetime: Clear once before each fixed input/update pass and on context changes; no retained Lua references.
policy.overflow: New key is not stored; later pure query logs a missing sample and uses native raw fallback.
diagnostics: bounded input-cache-miss key and reason detail

standalone_test.execution: x86 Windows executable via WSL interop
coverage: Actual guarded detour installation and both RET16 ABIs, with 1000 native then 1000 pure calls per typed wrapper
False override distinct from nil; bool/float output untouched on nil or miss
Exact float negative-zero and NaN payload bits
Different input hooks, null entity, and changed entity Index
Latest authoritative sample and recursive inner-nil/outer-override completion order
Repeated outside-render updates still execute when previous render role was pure
Fixed-tick, scene epoch, dispatcher ref, callback mask and same-address VM-close invalidation
Prior close-chain forwarding and partial-install rollback
4096-key bound and replacement of an existing key at capacity
standalone_test.not_exercised: No game launch, physical controller, live Lua VM replacement, multiplayer or arbitrary native hook replacement.

points: Install after shader cache; shutdown before it to preserve chained lua_close order
BeginTick runs once before each real fixed Update19715, including native input sampling, not once per presentation

single_controller.source: process-local synthetic XInput through native engine APIs

extra_updates_and_lifecycle.live_VM_replacement: not observed; same-address VM reuse remains unit coverage

runtime_validation.missing_queries: Zero reported in the listed release cases. Unknown queries still log and use the original caller raw-input branch; no general compatibility inference.

limits: Latest-result sampling does not emulate arbitrary Lua that intentionally varies by query ordinal on pure frames.
Only callback scalar results are cached; upstream final raw input queries are deliberately not cached.
Unit success does not validate multiplayer/online semantics or every custom input filter.
Arbitrary third-party native hook hot replacement is not an established shutdown guarantee.
